news.title: U.S. regulator warns prediction markets against cutting corners in event contracts
news.summary: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission again issued an advisory that signals firms have been straying into cookie-cutter self-certification.

news.title: Europe's high regulatory bar could spark new crypto industry M&A wave
news.summary: As MiCA beds in and the U.K. finalizes its crypto framework, stringent regulation could spur mergers, acquisitions and closer ties with banks.

news.title: Shiba Inu surges 36% as South Korean traders fuel mystery rally
news.summary: The rally has no announcement behind it, other dog tokens haven't matched it, and Korean venues are carrying the volume.

news.title: Crypto exchange BitMart to shut down after nine years, BMX token crashes 58%
news.summary: Users have a month to close trades and six months to withdraw, and the exchange gave no specific reason for closing.

news.title: Russia’s largest bank Sberbank plans crypto trading infrastructure by December
news.summary: New regulations for crypto trading, custody, and settlement in Russia take effect Sept. 1, with requirements for licensed intermediaries applying from July 2027.

news.title: North Korea arrests hackers accused of laundering stolen funds from country's bank via crypto
news.summary: The group allegedly breached Central Bank systems, converted crypto to cash via Chinese brokers, and used small transfers to evade detection.

news.title: Democratizing weather derivatives through tokenization could be crypto's most important real-world use case
news.summary: Main Street, which faces the most significant climate-related financial risk, currently lacks an avenue to hedge weather-related risks, argues CoinDesk’s Omkar Godbole.

news.title: Robinhood Chain's real-world assets jump fivefold as tokenized stocks start trading in bigger size
news.summary: The chain built to put equities onchain has tripled in size since mid-July, and a dozen tokenized stocks are now each clearing $500,000 a day. Real-world assets are growing fast, though memecoins and stablecoins still dominate the chain.

news.title: The S&P 500’s earnings growth has gone bonkers thanks to one company
news.summary: Markets are gearing up for the busiest week of second-quarter earnings season.

news.title: ‘We are not romantically involved’: I’m marrying my platonic best friend of 20 years. Should I leave him my home?
news.summary: “I own my home outright, have no children or other dependents.”

news.title: There’s a technical ‘triple threat’ for stocks, but also places investors can hide
news.summary: Treasury yields and oil prices surged, and the dollar confirmed the breakout toward a longer-term uptrend, to push the S&P 500 below key chart support.

news.title: I will definitely claim Social Security early. Why do so few people talk about the elephant in the room?
news.summary: “The strongest argument for claiming benefits earlier goes beyond the traditional break-even analyses.”

news.title: The Treasury market is sending Fed Chair Kevin Warsh a clear warning about rates
news.summary: Rising Treasury yields show how “enormously worried” the market is about inflation — and whether the Fed will back up its tough talk with action

news.title: ‘I’m still confused’: I sold $80,000 in shares on June 30, so why didn’t I receive my dividend?
news.summary: “To my surprise, the proceeds from the sale were credited to my money-market settlement fund.”

news.title: ‘Time will tell whether that was a good bet’: My adviser got me a full SpaceX IPO allocation. Was I lucky?
news.summary: “Investors frequently receive only a small fraction of the shares they request — if they receive any at all.”
